cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make Them Your Deputy
cards.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

mechanism: A recruits picnic work under A planning authority, using packing and allergy-check corrections to make B responsible for execution while A alone directs.
confusable: Simple division of labour could be equal partnership; A must insist B help remains subordinate even when B offers to share or make decisions.
comparison: Raffle alternative withholds financial decisions; picnic alternative reserves menu changes and final checks.
seedUse: Picnic second-in-command and equal-work objection derive from D49-b; S03 adds an actual packing decision rather than an abstract wording task.
